description: Implementation of a Software Defined Radio (SDR) controller for a radio unit, managing start/stop operations, timing synchronization, and control of physical layer parameters such as gain, frequency, and CFO for multiple sectors.

classes.name: ru_controller_sdr_impl
classes.description: Main controller class for SDR radio unit, managing timing, start/stop, and sector configurations.

classes.name: ru_gain_controller_sdr_impl
classes.description: Controller for setting transmit and receive gains.

classes.name: ru_cfo_controller_sdr_impl
classes.description: Controller for setting CFO (Carrier Frequency Offset) for sectors.

classes.name: ru_center_frequency_controller_sdr_impl
classes.description: Controller for setting transmit and receive center frequencies.

classes.name: ru_tx_time_offset_controller_sdr_impl
classes.description: Controller for setting transmit time offsets.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts radio and physical layer sectors at a specified time, synchronizing with 1PPS or a delay.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops radio and physical layer sectors.

methods.name: set_lower_phy_sectors
methods.description: Configures the list of physical layer sectors managed by the controller.

methods.name: set_tx_gain
methods.description: Sets the transmit gain for a specified port.

methods.name: set_rx_gain
methods.description: Sets the receive gain for a specified port.

methods.name: set_tx_cfo
methods.description: Schedules a CFO command for a specific sector.

methods.name: set_rx_cfo
methods.description: Schedules a CFO command for a specific sector.

methods.name: set_tx_center_frequency
methods.description: Sets the transmit center frequency for a sector.

methods.name: set_rx_center_frequency
methods.description: Sets the receive center frequency for a sector.

methods.name: set_tx_time_offset
methods.description: Sets the transmit time offset for a sector.
